message.title: Subsea 7 - CADE Approves the Combination of Subsea7 and Saipem
message.body:
Luxembourg - 4 November 2026 - Subsea 7 S.A. (Oslo Børs: SUBC, ADR: SUBCY) today
announced  that  the  tribunal  of  Brazil's  Conselho  Administrativo de Defesa
Econômica  (CADE) has approved the proposed combination of Subsea7 and Saipem to
create  Saipem7 subject to compliance  with the commitments set  out in a Merger
Control Agreement.

Subsea7  and  Saipem  have  committed  to  divest  Seven Borealis to address the
competition concerns raised by CADE's tribunal during its review. The commitment
includes  specific  provisions  to  ensure  continuity  in  the execution of the
existing project backlog.

The  divestiture is not expected to materially affect the strategic rationale of
the proposed combination, and the synergies previously announced are confirmed.

Subsea7  and Saipem remain firmly committed to the proposed combination and will
continue  to work constructively with the  relevant authorities to secure prompt
satisfaction  (or, where applicable, waiver) of the remaining conditions set out
in the common merger plan approved by the shareholders of both companies.

*******************************************************************************

Subsea7 is a global leader in the delivery of offshore projects and services for
the evolving energy industry, creating sustainable value by being the industry's
partner and employer of choice in delivering the efficient offshore solutions
the world needs.

Subsea7 is listed on the Oslo Børs (SUBC), ISIN LU0075646355, LEI
222100AIF0CBCY80AH62.
